title: revert: remove paid model filter
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Removes the Hide paid control and local paid-model filtering.
- Restores the previous search and empty-state behavior.
- Preserves the later community-model privacy disclosure.

Reverts #13779 and #13755.

gist.headline: The model shelf is whole again
gist.blurb: The model browser has put its full catalog back on the shelf. Polli removed one overly enthusiastic filter drawer, while keeping the community-model privacy note where it belongs.
gist.summary: Removed the Hide paid control and local paid-model filtering in the Models UI, restoring the previous search behavior and empty states while retaining the community-model privacy disclosure.
gist.impact: Users can again search and browse the complete model catalog without a local paid-model filter changing results or producing the newer empty-state behavior.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy model-library garden where every model seed packet is visible again on a retro terminal shelf, with the removed filter represented as a small closed drawer labeled "HIDE PAID" being gently set aside. Polli, wearing librarian glasses, helps the eager monitor robot browse the full collection; a small privacy-note sign remains beside a community flower bed.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, a cute yellow bee with dark brown stripes, black antennae and oval eyes, pink rectangular cheek blush, a happy smile, light blue translucent wings, and tiny librarian glasses, helping a CRT monitor robot browse a full shelf of glowing model seed packets on a retro terminal; a small filter drawer labeled "HIDE PAID" rests neatly aside while a community flower bed keeps a tiny privacy-note sign. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, code-plants and flowers, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, nostalgic but beautiful.
